risks.title: BOM is on sheet 2 only
risks.rationale: Part quantities live on page 2; an extractor that only reads page 1 will miss all parts and quantities.
risks.mitigation: Ensure all pages are rasterized and parsed (page-budget must cover the BOM sheet).

risks.title: Dissimilar metals (cast iron body + aluminum cover)
risks.rationale: Cast iron and aluminum in contact with moisture can drive galvanic corrosion.
risks.mitigation: Use a gasket/isolation and compatible fasteners.

tasks.title: Verify all BOM pages were parsed
